title: Access Fleet: Streamlined role bundles & bulk member assignment flow
creator: Liam Chen
description: Design a concise, high-confidence flow for assigning multiple users to curated role bundles ("role bundles" = groupings of permissions and optional constraints) inside the Console. This ticket covers the UI for selecting pre-packaged role bundles, bulk member selection (emails, SSO groups), inline validation against audit & compliance constraints, and final confirmation with change diff and rollback guidance. Goal: reduce time-to-complete for org admins while preserving auditable mutation events and minimizing accidental over-permissioning.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can search and select one or more role bundles and preview the combined permission surface before assignment.
Bulk member input accepts emails, CSV upload, and SSO group references; validation highlights invalid identifiers with actionable messages.
Before commit, UI presents a compact permission delta (added/removed/elevated) and potential policy conflicts (e.g., mutually exclusive roles).
All assignment actions generate a clear audit message template and an option to require secondary approval, tied to the audit log entry.
Flow includes a lightweight undo within a sandbox window (30 minutes) and documents the required backend rollback semantics for engineers.
Design passes accessibility review and meets color/contrast and keyboard navigation requirements.
Telemetry hooks exist to record step completion times and where users drop out of the flow for follow-up.
Edge cases: when SSO group sync lags, UI surfaces last-sync timestamp and a 'force sync' hint linking to SSO integrations page.
Internationalization: permission names and microcopy are externalized to translation files.
Performance: list rendering of members must support 10k+ entries with progressive loading and summary counts.
